preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has length between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s.isalpha() for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s consists only of Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'yEs', 'yES', 'YeS', 'YeS', 'yEsS', 'YESs', 'YESsS'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid case-insensitive YES/NO answer.

postconditions.expression: all((any(s == ''.join(['Yes'] * k)[i:i+len(s)] for k in range(1, 1000) for i in range(len(''.join(['Yes'] * k)) - len(s) + 1)) if ''.join(['Yes'] * k).find(s) != -1) == (stdout_lines[i] in ['YES', 'Yes', 'yes', 'yEs', 'yES', 'YeS', 'YESs', 'YESsS']) for i, s in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case string s, the output is YES if and only if s is a substring of some repetition of 'Yes' (e.g., 'YesYesYes...').
